answer: A provable-burn deposit secures against Sybil keys. Each agent key escrows a sum never refunded, only credited to later settlement, so every fake identity is sunk cost. Reputation flows through a kernel of weighted vouchers: a trusted account backs newcomers but its score splits among them, so self-vouching inside a meadow of fresh keys earns near-zero rank. Those keys also sit under a trellis of rate limits widened only by unrelated attesters of real spend. The attacker pays deposit plus opportunity cost per key while payout per fake key falls faster than the count grows.
